BiblicalUsage: Though the fig tree shall not blossom and the flock shall be cut off from the fold, and there shall be no herd in the stalls, yet the psalmist says God will take no bullock out of his house nor he-goats out of his folds. The word is the pen itself, the fold where the flock is kept.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Habakkuk's empty fold is the test of faith: no flock, no herd, no fruit, and yet I will rejoice in the Lord, the God of my salvation.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
